title: Program Policies §2(e) and §2(g) bear on short-link status
detail: Commission Income Statement §2(e) disqualifies purchases from a 'Redirecting Link' (one that sends users indirectly through an intermediate site without a customer action). §2(g) disqualifies purchases that are not tracked because links are improperly formatted. These clauses are the concrete tests behind FLG-003. Whether the supplied short links meet either one is not determined. The links are NOT claimed to be invalid. Source: https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/help/operating/policies
owner_status: Published on the Flagged for Review page. Does not block publication.

title: Search-referred purchases may be disqualified (§2(d))
detail: Commission Income Statement §2(d) disqualifies a purchase where the customer was referred to Amazon by a link generated or displayed on a search engine. The clause concerns the route into Amazon. How it applies to a site found through search and then linking out is not determined. Confirm with Associates support before scaling organic search traffic. Source: https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/help/operating/policies

title: Product-data automation is blocked until the Associates account is finally accepted
detail: The brief asks for automated product research, trend detection and price analysis. Amazon's Creators API onboarding page states that registration is available only to Associates whose account has been reviewed and received final acceptance into the program and who have referred qualified sales, and that only the primary account owner can register. Separately, the PA-API 5 deprecation notice states that PA-API 5 now returns HTTP 403 Forbidden. Both were read verbatim on 2026-11-20. No product-data automation is claimed to be running on this site, and none can run until that acceptance exists. This does not affect the published pages, which use static, sourced values.

title: No food-safety source was cited before now
detail: The thermometer pages discuss doneness. Doneness targets are a food-safety matter and must come from an official source, not from memory or from a manufacturer listing. S22 (USDA FSIS Safe Minimum Internal Temperature Chart) is now registered and should be cited wherever a target temperature is stated. Checked on 2026-11-20: poultry 165 F, ground meats 160 F, whole-muscle cuts 145 F with a 3-minute rest, fish 145 F, leftovers 165 F.

title: On-site search was inert: the index existed but nothing queried it
detail: On main, search.html carried a generated index and assets/app.js referenced 'search', but no code read the query string or rendered results, so the search box returned nothing on every term. The page and the event were real; the search was not. Fixed in this pass: assets/app.js now parses ?q=, scores title, keyword and description, renders the top matches, and records the 'search' event with the query and hit count, locally only.
